need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed app for Gusto, and Gusto only issues production credentials to approved integrations, so you need your own approved app.

scenarios.label: Production integration for outside customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects Gusto accounts of customers outside your company, directly or via an approved Unified API partner.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; the security documents may take longest to gather

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "1-2 weeks for pre-approval, plus security review and QA of unknown length").

scenarios.approval: Production Pre-Approval by the Partnerships team, then a Security Review, then QA, before production credentials are issued.
extras: Development calls only on the demo domain

modifiers.note: Development calls only on the demo domain

prerequisites.title: Gusto Developer Account
prerequisites.detail: Sign up before filing the Production Pre-Approval application.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation
prerequisites.detail: Gather SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS reports plus penetration test reports and policies. Without a formal audit, describe controls such as background checks, MFA, encryption and vulnerability management.

prerequisites.title: Security and incident contacts
prerequisites.detail: Provide a security contact and an incident response contact with name, title and email.

steps.title: Sign up for a Gusto Developer Account
steps.detail: Create the account on Gusto's developer portal.
steps.done_when: You can log in to the Developer Portal.

steps.title: Draft security and use-case answers
steps.detail: Prepare the questionnaire answers: use case, minimum scopes, security controls and policy summaries from your documents.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit Production Pre-Approval application
steps.detail: Review the drafted answers, attach audits and contacts, then submit.

steps.title: Wait for Partnerships review
steps.detail: Gusto states a 1-2 week review, then the security review starts if approved.
steps.done_when: You receive approval and the Security Review starts.

steps.title: Respond to security review requests
steps.detail: Gusto may ask for more information, and the review is on hold until you answer.

steps.title: Build and test in demo environment
steps.detail: Call api.gusto-demo.com with the assigned scopes. Check granted scopes in the Developer Portal.
steps.done_when: Integration works in demo and passes Gusto QA.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the gusto auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret, using the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard.

traps.title: No production test accounts
traps.detail: All testing, before and after launch, must happen in the demo environment. Plan tests there.

traps.title: Security review can stall
traps.detail: Review is put on hold until you answer any extra information request. Watch your email.

traps.title: Scopes are assigned, not chosen
traps.detail: Gusto assigns scopes per use case, and calls outside them are rejected in production. Changes after launch need an email request.

traps.title: Rate limit per grant
traps.detail: 200 requests per minute per OAuth grant; excess calls get HTTP 429 until the window closes.

blockers.what_it_means: Gusto issues production credentials only after approval and QA.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete pre-approval, security review and QA first.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft questionnaire answers and a QA checklist.

blockers.what_it_means: The 200 requests per minute limit was reached.
blockers.what_to_do: Back off until the 60-second window closes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Add rate limiting and retry logic.
